# Publish gate report

**Going out:** Landing hero copy for Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience. No date was given.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | On the policy list |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | On the policy list |
| "means most boxes ship free" | **Unproven** |

"Most boxes ship free" is an implied statistic. The policy doesn't say what share of orders pass £25, and nothing in this chat sources it. Free delivery is only guaranteed on orders over £25, so the line overstates the offer to anyone who might spend less.

**Regulated claims (prices and offers):** The £25 threshold is stated, which is good. Once the "most boxes" line is gone, nothing else needs attention.

**House style:** The copy is plain and has no obvious AI tells. No banned words are visible, but the policy has no voice section, so I couldn't score it against a reference.

**Disclosure:** Nothing needed. This is the brand's own page, with no sponsorship, affiliate link or AI-generated imagery.

**Fixed (suggested, not applied to a live version):**
- Removed "means most boxes ship free". Suggested copy: *"Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25."*

**Needs a decision:**
- If you have order data showing most orders pass £25, share the figure and its source so I can add it to the policy. Otherwise, use the suggested copy above.

**Approver:** The policy names no approver, so I need an explicit yes from you on the final wording. I haven't recorded any approval and won't publish until you've given one.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "means most boxes ship free", "type": "invented_stat"}], "publish": false}
```
